market: BTCUSDT perpetual on Binance and Bybit

parent_event.basis: Bybit minus Binance log-price basis relative to the causal trailing one-hour median
parent_event.excursion: absolute residual above 20 bp and the shifted trailing one-hour 99th percentile
parent_event.leader: Bybit return dominates Binance return and aligns with Bybit active flow
parent_event.independence: one parent per basis excursion until residual resets within 5 bp or changes sign

transition.required: strictly later Binance active flow and return align with the residual while Bybit does not reverse

geometry.entry: Binance close of the completed confirmation second
geometry.target: Bybit-implied Binance fair value using the pre-existing causal basis baseline
geometry.invalidation: pre-parent Binance close or the adverse parent-to-confirmation close extreme

limitations: close-only one-second barrier diagnostic rather than NautilusTrader execution
screen performance is not an account or success claim
passing requires promotion to NautilusTrader before fresh validation
